$comment: Canonical model registry for the Neelverse Marketing Suite (DMP / ContentForge / SocialForge). Update this file then run scripts/sync_model_registry.sh to distribute: each sibling copy is this file minus the DMP-only families listed in scripts/registry_mirror.py. The resolver consults this registry to map human-readable aliases to concrete model IDs and to warn when a deprecated model is being used. See refresh_models.py to poll provider APIs for drift.
last_updated_by: manual refresh from vendor pages read 2026-10-27; see _shared/REGISTRY-PATCH-2026-10-27.md; speech kinds (text-to-speech, speech-to-text) added in DMP 3.37.2 as pins with an expiry
stewardship_policy: Re-validate at least quarterly OR whenever a script call returns a 404 / deprecation warning. Frontier model landscape shifts every ~6 weeks; treat any entry older than 3 months as suspect. Verify the next time `refresh_models.py` reports drift, or before any new feature ship.

param_compatibility_notes.anthropic_sampling_parameters: From API version 2026-10-21 (the current SDK and CLI majors) temperature, top_p and top_k are removed from Messages and Message Batches requests for EVERY model: a request that sends any of them returns HTTP 400, even at the default value. On the older version 2023-06-01, Claude 4.7 and later (Opus 4.7, 4.8, 5, 5.5, Sonnet 5, 5.5, Fable 5, 5.1, Haiku 5.5) and Claude Mythos Preview already return 400 for a non-default value. Omit all three on every Anthropic call. Sources: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/model-deprecations (API parameter deprecations) and https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/migration-2026-10-21. Read 2026-10-27.
param_compatibility_notes.gemini_sampling_params: Gemini API deprecated temperature, top_p and top_k on 2026-07-21 (changelog). Omit them. Source: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/changelog
param_compatibility_notes.openai_video: OpenAI has NO video generation model as of 2026-10-04: the Sora 2 models and the Videos API shut down 2026-09-24 with no replacement listed. Source: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/deprecations
param_compatibility_notes.veo_backend: Veo 3.1 is served by Vertex AI only (veo-3.1-generate-001 and veo-3.1-fast-generate-001, GA since 2025-11-17, retirement 'November 17, 2026 or later'). The Gemini API shut every Veo 3.1 PREVIEW id on 2026-10-22 and lists no Veo model; its video model is gemini-omni-1.1-flash, called with client.interactions.create (google-genai >= 2.28.0). A GEMINI_API_KEY alone cannot make a Veo clip. Veo 3.1 takes 4, 6 or 8 second clips only. Sources: Vertex model-versions and Veo 3.1 pages, Gemini API deprecations and Omni pages, read 2026-10-27.

tiers.frontier: Best-in-class capability, highest cost. Use for complex reasoning, multi-step planning, agentic flows.
tiers.balanced: Mid-tier capability and cost. Default for production workloads.
tiers.fast: Optimised for low latency and low cost. Use for high-volume / simple tasks.
tiers.frontier-image-character: Specialised for consistent character / face preservation.
tiers.frontier-multimodal: Native handling of text + image + audio + video in one call.
tiers.balanced-video: Production-grade video generation, lower cost than the frontier video tier.
tiers.text-to-speech: Turns text into speech. Pinned with an expiry: no vendor list endpoint tells speech models from chat models, so each entry is re-read at the vendor's page before its pin_expires date.
tiers.speech-to-text: Transcribes speech to text. Pinned with an expiry, like text-to-speech.
